# Eventmagix

> Eventmagix is an all-in-one native mobile event app platform for iOS and Android, delivering attendee networking, gamification, and real-time engagement for conferences and events.

Eventmagix helps event organizers launch 100% native mobile apps that engage attendees, empower sponsors, and simplify event management. A VERUS Group company.
